purpose: Confirm on fresh worlds that temporary underground disruption can create a persistent rooted-stock deficit while increasing replacement pressure, and that realized post-intervention replacement flow predicts rebound.

design.post_intervention: Both branches use underground disruption rate zero from day 240 through day 360.
design.model_semantics: Current implemented semantics are frozen; the documented disrupted_sympathy_retention mismatch is not corrected inside this evidence stream.

primary_predictions: Mean treatment-minus-baseline rooted armed membership is negative at day 240.
Mean treatment-minus-baseline rooted armed membership remains negative at day 360.
Mean treatment-minus-baseline recruitment hazard is positive at day 360.
Mean treatment-minus-baseline eligible recruitment mass is positive at day 360.
The Pearson correlation across paired worlds between post-intervention excess recruited mass (day 240 to day 360) and day-360 rooted-membership effect exceeds +0.50.
The day-360 rebound fraction is higher among worlds with positive post-intervention excess recruited mass than among worlds with nonpositive post-intervention excess recruited mass.
secondary_predictions: Mean treatment-minus-baseline foothold strength is positive at day 360.
The sign of the mean fielded-force effect is not preregistered; it is reported descriptively because the earlier lagged-force claim failed replication.
Treatment-minus-baseline recruitment hazard and eligible recruitment mass are reported at both day 240 and day 360.
rebound_definition: Treatment day-360 rooted armed membership exceeds paired baseline day-360 rooted armed membership.
replacement_flow_definition: Treatment cumulative recruited represented population minus paired baseline cumulative recruited represented population over the same interval.
integrity_gate: Exactly 24 seeds x 2 cells x 3 timepoints must occur once each.
Every within-seed day-60 scientific output must be identical across 000 and 001.
The factor flags must match cell codes.
All 38 legacy outcome columns must remain measurement-compatible with the existing runner semantics.
interpretation_rules: Passing the stock and pressure predictions supports a dynamic stock-pressure divergence in the implemented model.
Passing the flow-correlation and rebound-risk predictions supports compensatory recruitment as a discriminator of rebound versus durable suppression.
Failure of either flow prediction means the 16-seed post-outcome decomposition did not generalize and must be demoted.
No operational or historical claim follows from this synthetic confirmation.
